name: Robert A. Kashfian
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Los Angeles, California

about: Attorney Robert A. Kashfian is a founding partner of Kashfian & Kashfian, LLP, law firm in Los Angeles, California. A top-ranked trial and appellate lawyer with more than 12 years of total legal experience, Mr. Kashfian provides unmatched counsel and support to a wide range of clients throughout Los Angeles County and the surrounding areas who have legal needs involving any of the following:

A highly personable and accessible attorney, Mr. Kashfian helped established his practice with his twin brother in order to deliver the highest level of representation possible to clients throughout his area. Since that time, he has achieved remarkable success fighting for the rights and interests of his clients in state and federal courts, and he has gained a reputation for his in-depth legal knowledge and outstanding trial skills as well as the innovative and customized solutions and strategies he provides for his clients.

In honor of his impeccable professionalism, Mr. Kashfian has earned consistent recognition from his peers as being among the top 2.5% of lawyers in his region, and he has received Superb client ratings on Avvo along with many testimonials and referrals from those he has served.

Mr. Kashfian received his bachelor's degrees cum laude in international relations and political science from the University of Southern California in 2004 and his master's degree in international relations from the same in 2005. He also received his professional master's degree in public administration from the university's School of Policy in 2006 before attending Southwestern Law School, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 2008.

A leader in his field, Mr. Kashfian currently serves as legal professor at Glendale University School of Law, and he teaches business and law at California State University, Northridge. He is admitted to practice in California and the District of Columbia as well as before the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit and Bankruptcy Appellate Panel. He also holds his admission to practice before various U.S. District Courts across the country.
